decision.observation: The pointer rests exactly on the lower latch pipe elbow at ~(0.63, 0.66), which is right beside the goose's beak and body. The upper latch pipe with hook sits on the top rail at ~(0.65, 0.44).
decision.hypothesis: A plain left-press grab on the elbow (no Ctrl, no movement) may make the goose bite and grip the latch handle; then a separate walk click left will drag it and swing the gate open.
decision.memory: Grab attempts cause sparkles when contact registers; the drag step via a separate click was only occasionally performed.
